# fct_portal_page_views

`data-warehouse-359101.analytics.fct_portal_page_views` · dbt area: `portal`

Fact table of Advisor Portal page views reconstructed from Segment's multi-event structure. Each row is a unique page view with engagement time, page path hierarchy (4 levels), previous/following page paths and event flags. NOTE Segment does not track 100% of sessions -- users can opt out of analytics tracking. Sourced from Segment.

| Column | Description |
|---|---|
| `page_view_id` | Primary Key. Unique ID assigned to each page view using the user_id, page sequence, and page path. >> SOURCE - Segment data_tests: - unique - not_null |
| `blended_user_id` | Foreign Key. The identifier used for sessionization - uses anonymous_id when user_id is 0, otherwise uses user_id. >> SOURCE - Segment |
| `context_user_ip_address` | The user's IP Address. >> SOURCE - Segment |
| `event_count` | The number of individual events that occur during a page visit. >> SOURCE - Segment |
| `following_page_path` | The destination path of the URL, such as '/clients', from the page AFTER the current one. >> SOURCE - Segment |
| `page_engagement_time_sec` | The time spent on the page, calculated by the difference in timestamps. Pages at the end of a session do not have a page_engagement_time. >> SOURCE - Segment |
| `page_query_string` | The query string (after the '?') in the URL from the first event in the page view. >> SOURCE - Segment |
| `page_subdomain` | The subdomain of the URL. Examples include advisor or trips. >> SOURCE - Segment |
| `page_title` | The title of the page from the first event in the page view; comes from the <title> in the HTML. >> SOURCE - Segment |
| `page_url` | The path + query string of URL from the first event in the page view. >> SOURCE - Segment |
| `page_path_level_1` | Only the first level of the path (right after the first slash). >> SOURCE - Segment |
| `page_path_level_2` | Only the second level of the path (right after the second slash). >> SOURCE - Segment |
| `page_path_level_3` | Only the third level of the path (right after the third slash). >> SOURCE - Segment |
| `page_path_level_4` | Only the fourth level of the path (right after the fourth slash). >> SOURCE - Segment |
| `page_view_at` | Timestamp of when the page view started. >> SOURCE - Segment |
| `previous_page_path` | The destination path of the URL, such as '/bookings', from the page BEFORE the current one. >> SOURCE - Segment |
| `session_id` | Foreign Key. Unique ID assigned to each session using the user_id and session_sequence. >> SOURCE - Segment |
| `user_id` | Foreign Key. The 'User ID' in the Portal database. >> SOURCE - Segment |
